newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates gain amid bargain hunting.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates gain amid bargain hunting.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates rose slightly on Saturday amid bargain hunting by mill owners and dealers said they expected prices to gain on demand from exporters.
"Trading remained dull today as the mill owners are short of liquidty. But prices gained slightly on selective buying," dealer Kishan Chand said. "The prices will rise on demand from exporters."
The kerb rate for NIAB-78 variety was 2,100 rupees ($52.21) per maund (37.32 kg), while K-68 was traded at 2,200 rupees, dealers said.
